info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Jobs API

params.name: id
params.description: Only return job with the given id

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: Only return jobs part of a process with the given id

params.name: withoutProcessInstanceId
params.description: If true, only returns jobs without a process instance id set. If false, the withoutProcessInstanceId parameter is ignored.

params.name: executionId
params.description: Only return jobs part of an execution with the given id

params.name: processDefinitionId
params.description: Only return jobs with the given process definition id

params.name: elementId
params.description: Only return jobs with the given element id

params.name: elementName
params.description: Only return jobs with the given element name

params.name: handlerType
params.description: Only return jobs with the given handler type

params.name: handlerTypes
params.description: Only return jobs which have one of the given job handler type

params.name: executable
params.description: If true, only return jobs which are executable. If false, this parameter is ignored.

params.name: timersOnly
params.description: If true, only return jobs which are timers. If false, this parameter is ignored. Cannot be used together with 'messagesOnly'.

params.name: messagesOnly
params.description: If true, only return jobs which are messages. If false, this parameter is ignored. Cannot be used together with 'timersOnly'

params.name: withException
params.description: If true, only return jobs for which an exception occurred while executing it. If false, this parameter is ignored.

params.name: dueBefore
params.description: Only return jobs which are due to be executed before the given date. Jobs without duedate are never returned using this parameter.

params.name: dueAfter
params.description: Only return jobs which are due to be executed after the given date. Jobs without duedate are never returned using this parameter.

params.name: exceptionMessage
params.description: Only return jobs with the given exception message

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return jobs with the given tenantId.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return jobs with a tenantId like the given value.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns jobs without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: locked
params.description: If true, only return jobs which are locked.  If false, this parameter is ignored.

params.name: unlocked
params.description: If true, only return jobs which are unlocked. If false, this parameter is ignored.

params.name: withoutScopeId
params.description: If true, only returns jobs without a scope id set. If false, the withoutScopeId parameter is ignored.

params.name: withoutScopeType
params.description: If true, only returns jobs without a scope type set. If false, the withoutScopeType parameter is ignored.

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.
